Alex — thanks for the note. Quick answers below:

- Current stage: "Procurement Review" (we've cleared legal but procurement still needs to validate billing account).
- Procurement owner: Priya Malhotra (procurement@heliocare.com) — looping her on the thread.
- Target PO date: our current plan is to issue by 2027-03-29 but that's contingent on one outstanding item: a short data processing addendum (DPA) we need from your legal team to satisfy our security policy. If the DPA is quick, PO will land this month; if it requires internal legal review changes it could slip into April.

Given the uncertainty on the DPA timeline I would mark this as YELLOW and include a contingency to secure a temporary credit hold (30 days) if PO misses 3/31.
